lead: Triple H is best known as an American professional wrestler, born on 27 July 1969 in Nashua.
As of 2026, he is 57 years old, and his birth date places him under the Leo sign.
He has 9 credited works on public record and has been recognised with WWE Hall of Fame and Wrestling Observer Newsletter Hall of Fame.
